# Service Management Contract Parity

URL: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/reference/service-management-contract-parity

What each export guarantees: OAS 3.1, AsyncAPI, proto, codegen bundle and round-trip fidelity.

Headings:
- Service Management Contract Parity Guarantees
- Guarantee 1 — the OAS 3.1 export is boilerplate-consumable (JUM-474)
- Guarantee 2 — AsyncAPI 3.0 per transport and a canonical proto (JUM-475)
- Guarantee 3 — the codegen bundle is deliverable code (JUM-476)
- Guarantee 4 — round-trip fidelity, with the honest boundaries (JUM-471, JUM-478)
- Symmetric crossings (lossless, deep-equal asserted)
- The OAS crossing: fixed point, empty loss list
- The boundaries that remain (named, asserted, not swept away)
- One-way exporters
- Where the gates enforce all of this
- RBAC alignment and the divergence it reconciled (JUM-477)
- Full-suite export and the `runtimeEnvironment` decision (JUM-547, landed)
- References

# Service Management Cana Adoption

URL: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/reference/service-management-cana-adoption

The single-store decision, the one-way migration and the offline state matrix.

Headings:
- Service Management Cana Adoption, Migration and Offline Behaviour
- The one fact everything else follows from: no fallback
- Migration: one-way, verified, terminal (JUM-484)
- Offline behaviour: everything works, and "offline" is not "safe"
- The state matrix: what you see, what you can do
- Private/incognito or blocked storage — non-persisting session
- A browser without usable IndexedDB — unsupported environment
- Persistence not granted — degraded durability
- Quota near exhaustion — warning before failure
- Quota exhausted — the write did not happen
- Evicted database — data loss, declared
- Corrupted record — lost, not empty, announced, and the designer recovers
- Unknown write outcome — worker crash after dispatch
- Multi-tab behaviour (JUM-485)
- Export and backup
- Troubleshooting
- Known follow-ups
- What this document deliberately does not cover
- References
